terminals.name: site-dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server for apps/site on http://localhost:3000. Runs `next dev` directly (the committed `pnpm dev` uses `sst dev`, which needs AWS). Renders live Tinybird charts when the TINYBIRD_TOKEN_DASHBOARD and USER_EMAIL secrets are set, otherwise the app's built-in 'User email not set' state.
